finalResult.nextParagraphText: “You must know by now that the Forest Fae was the ringleader. They all followed her lead to slay you and potentially even me.” the Sovereign shook his head before looking directly at Jake.
finalResult.previousParagraphText: “I just told you before. We do it for survival,” the Sovereign said. “If the grudge hampers survival, it goes against my Path far more.
